reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 배송오자마자 착용해봤어요 아이 사이즈에도 잘맞고 다른것보다 부드러운거 같아요
reviews.content_en: I put it on as soon as it arrived. It fits my pup's size well and feels softer than other products.

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
반려견운동장이나 카페 이용할 때 매너벨트 필수라 여러 제품 써봤는데 보솜 기저귀 착용감이 너무 좋아요! 
소변 콸콸해도 흡수력 뛰어나서 찝찝하지 않고 소변 알림선 너무 유용해요..!!!!!!
reviews.content_en: I've tried several products since diapers are essential when using dog parks or cafes, but BITE ME's absorbent diaper feels amazing! Even with heavy peeing, the absorption is so good that there's no discomfort, and the pee indicator line is super useful..!!!!!!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
아가들 첫 기저귀가 바잇미 보솜기저귀라서 참 좋아요
흡수력도 좋고 착용도 쉽고 무엇보다 아가처럼 귀여워요ㅠㅠ
마침 둘째가 생리기간이라 채워봤는데 처음에 어색해하지만 금방 적응하네요^^ 이제 애들 데리고 여행 걱정도 없습니다

사이즈는 상세설명에 허리둘레 재고 s했는데 딱맞아요!
reviews.content_en:
I'm so happy that BITE ME absorbent diapers were my babies' first diapers 💕 The absorption is great, it's easy to put on, and most of all they're as cute as my babies ㅠㅠ My second pup just started her period so I tried it out, and while she was confused at first, she adapted quickly^^ Now I can travel with the kids without worry!

For sizing, I measured the waist circumference according to the detailed description and went with S, and it fits perfectly!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
2.4키로 xs사이즈 딱이에요! 일단 기존에 쓰던 타브랜드 제품보다 훨씬 도톰해서 너무 좋네요🥹🖤 
디자인도 너무 귀엽고 접착하는 부분도 튼튼합니다~!
reviews.content_en: At 2.4kg, XS is perfect! First of all, it's way thicker than the other brand product I used before, so I'm really happy 🥹🖤 The design is so cute and the adhesive tabs are sturdy too~!

reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content:
체험단으로 선정되어 처음 바잇미 보솜 기저귀를 사용하게 되었습니다. 타 브랜드 기저귀를 사용했었는데, 기저귀 내려감 문제로 조금 불편함이 있었어요. 강아지가 조금 몸부림을 치거나, 흥분하면 줄줄 아래로 내려와서 기저귀가 빠지곤 했습니다. 한쪽 찍찍이가 풀려버린적도 많았구요. 그럴때마다 계속 멈춰서 정리해줘야 했죠. 
그래서 바잇미 보솜 기저귀를 체험 할 때 그부분을 유심히 봤어요. 찍찍이는 튼튼한가, 털거나 흥분할때 기저귀가 내려가지는 않는지 여부를 확인했죠. 찍찍이는 튼튼해서 체험하면서 쉽게 떨어지는 경우가 없었어요. 우리집 강아지가 깔끔쟁이라 산책할때마다 자주 터는데, 그때도 내려감 없이 잘 유지되더라구요! 그래서 너무 만족했습니다. 
또한 우리집 강아지는 변이 좀 굵은 편이라. 기저귀를 하고 산책할 때 늘 꼬리 구멍을 가위로 조금 더 자르는 편인데, 보솜 기저귀는 자를 수 있는 면적이 넓어서 좋더라구요. 기존에 쓰던 기저귀는 자를 수 있는 부분이 적어서 늘 솜부분까지 자르곤 했었거든요. 아이도 불편해하지 않고 흡수력도 좋고, 세세한 부분까지 다 만족해서 다음에 새 기저귀를 구매할때 보솜 기저귀로 구매하려고 합니다! 아주 마음에 들었어요:)
다만, 사이즈 설정 시 조금 실수가 있어서 다음엔 L사이즈 말고 M사이즈를 사려고 합니다. 7kg 후반 ~ 8kg 초반, 허리둘레 38-40정도 되는 강아지라 조금 넉넉하게 해주고 싶어 L 사이즈로 주문했어요. 둘레는 잘 맞는데 세로 길이가 좀 길어서 살짝 불편하더라구요. 그런데 그건 제가 사이즈를 잘못 고른 탓이라;; 다음에는 M사이즈를 사서 입히려고 합니다! 병원에 가거나 카페에 갈때 아주 유용하게 사용할것 같아요!
reviews.content_en:
I was selected as a product tester and got to try BITE ME absorbent diapers for the first time. I had used other brands before, but had some inconvenience with the diaper slipping down. When my pup wiggled a bit or got excited, it would slide right off. One of the adhesive tabs would come loose pretty often too. Every time that happened, I had to keep stopping to fix it.

So when testing BITE ME absorbent diapers, I paid close attention to that. I checked if the adhesive tabs were sturdy and whether the diaper would slip down when my pup shook or got excited. The adhesive tabs were sturdy and never came loose easily during the testing period. My pup is pretty fastidious and poops frequently during walks, but the diaper stayed in place without slipping at all! So I was really satisfied.

Also, since my pup tends to have thicker stools, I usually need to cut the tail hole a bit wider with scissors when wearing the diaper on walks. With BITE ME diapers, there's a wider area I can cut, which is great! With the previous brand, there was only a small area to cut, so I always ended up cutting into the absorbent part. My pup doesn't feel uncomfortable, the absorption is great, and I'm satisfied with every detail, so I'm planning to buy BITE ME diapers next time I get new ones! I really love it :)

One thing though - I made a small sizing mistake, so next time instead of L, I'm planning to get M size. My pup weighs between 7.5-8kg and has a waist circumference of about 38-40cm, so I ordered L size to give some extra room. The circumference fits well, but the length was a bit long, so it was slightly uncomfortable. But that's because I chose the wrong size ;;  Next time I'll get M size! It seems like it'll be really useful for vet visits or cafe trips!

reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content: 체험단으로 L사이즈를 체험해 보고 퀄리티가 너무 좋아서 L사이즈와 M사이즈를 돈주고 구매했습니다. 콩이는 L은 넉넉하게 M은 딱맞게 잘 맞아서 필요에 따라 쓰려고 두 사이즈를 구매했습니다. 수술한 뒤라 수술한곳을 보호하려고 L사이즈를 넉넉하게 입혀 산책다녀요.(실외배변견) 수술부위까지 딱 덮어주고 너무 좋더라구요! 무튼 퀄리티가 타브랜드 기저귀보다 좋아서 정착하려고 합니다.
reviews.content_en: I tested L size as a product tester and the quality was so good that I bought both L and M sizes with my own money. Konggi fits L comfortably and M perfectly, so I got both sizes depending on what I need. After my pup's surgery, I'm putting the L size on loosely to protect the surgical area during walks (outdoor pottying pup). It covers the surgical area perfectly and works great! Anyway, the quality is better than other brands so I'm sticking with it.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 계속 쓰던 다른 브랜드 기저귀보다 바잇미 기저귀가 더 큰데 훨씬 가볍고 재질이 좀 더 부드러워요. 쉬아 양이 많아도 잘 흡수되고 어떤 기저귀는 차면 불편해서 잘 못걷는데 이건 잘 걷고 잘 때도 안불편해 하더라구요 ! 다 쓰면 재구매하려구요 !
reviews.content_en: BITE ME diapers are bigger than the other brand I've been using, but they're much lighter and the material is softer. Even with heavy peeing, it absorbs well, and with some diapers my pup can't walk well because of discomfort, but with these they walk well and even sleep without being bothered! I'll repurchase when I run out!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
장거리 여행을 갈일이 있어서 구매했습니다~ 잠실팝업에서 우연히 산리오 콜라보 제품때문에 관심있게 본 브랜드였습니다^^
일단 가성비 너무 좋구요. 한번 쉬야하고 바로 갈지 않아도 흡습력이 너무 좋아서 2~3번 쉬야하고 갈아줘도 흐르거나 묻지 않았어요(갈아줄때쯤은 파란선으로 표시되서 너무 편합니다ㅎ)
아직 강쥐가 900g  밖에 안되서 사이즈 제일 작은거 사도 여유가 있지만 착용하고 다니기에 불편한 점은 없었습니다~
다 사용하면 또 구매하려구요^^
reviews.content_en:
I bought it because I had a long-distance trip planned~ I happened to notice this brand at the Jamsil pop-up because of the Sanrio collab product 😄

First, the value for money is amazing. Even if I don't change it right after one pee, the absorption is so good that I can change it after 2-3 times without any leaking or mess (and by the time I change it, the blue line shows up so it's super convenient ㅎ)

My pup is only 900g so there's still room even with the smallest size, but there's no discomfort wearing it~ I'll definitely repurchase when I run out ^^

reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content:
아이랑 캠핑을 다니면서 텐트 내에서 실례를 자주 하여 기저귀를 사용하는데 아이가 많이 자라 이전 쓰던게 안맞아 새로 구매해봤어요 
확실히 다른데보다 기저귀가 훨씬 도톰하고 넉넉해요 한 사이즈 작았어도 잘 맞았을것 같은데 꼬리가 없어 조금만 작아도 고정이 잘 안되었는데 찍찍이 부분도 넓직하고 허리 감싸주는 부분이 넉넉해서 확실히 편하고 좋아요 
또 소변양이 정말 많은 아이인데 확실히 습수력이 좋고 넘치지않고 커버가 잘 됩니다
reviews.content_en:
I go camping with my pup and they often have accidents inside the tent, so I use diapers. Since my pup has grown, the old ones don't fit anymore, so I bought new ones.

These diapers are definitely much thicker and roomier than other brands. Even one size smaller would've worked, but since there's no tail, it doesn't stay in place well if it's too small. These have wider adhesive tabs and the waistband wraps around generously, so they're definitely more comfortable and better.

Also, my pup pees a lot, and this definitely has great absorption, doesn't overflow, and covers everything well.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
세가지 브랜드 여러 사이즈 착용해본 결과
바잇미 라지가 제일 잘 맞는것 같아요
꼬리구멍이 좀 넓어서 대변이 삐져나온적이 있긴한데 ;; 평소 차고다니기엔 이게 좋아요 
오줌 누면 표시가 되어 갈아주기에도 좋습니다

처음에 허리둘레랑 몸무게 보고 M 샀는데 작았어요
사이즈 표를 좀 자세히 올려주시면 구매에 도움 될거에요
reviews.content_en:
After trying three different brands in various sizes,
BITE ME Large seems to fit the best.
The tail hole is a bit wide so poop has leaked out sometimes ;; But for everyday wear, this is good.
It shows a mark when they pee, which is convenient for changing.

At first I bought M based on waist circumference and weight, but it was too small.
It would be helpful if you provided more detailed sizing charts for purchases.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 흡수력도 브랜드꺼에 뒤지지 않고 밴드접착력도 우수하고 편리하며 샘방지 가드가 있어 많은양도 세지않아 좋아요 쉬하연 색이 변해서 알수있는것도 편해요 가성비 대만족입니다
reviews.content_en: The absorption is just as good as name brands, the adhesive tabs are excellent and convenient, and the leak guard prevents leaks even with larger amounts, which is great. The color change when they pee is also convenient for knowing when to change. Great value for money!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 사이즈가 애매해서 선택하지 어려웠는데 M사이즈 6키로 아이에게 작은듯 딱 맞아요 타제품 소형사이즈로 보면 되요 대신 꼬리쪽은 잘라줘야함 디자인 예쁘고 가성비제품 배송도 엄청 빨라요
reviews.content_en: It was hard to choose because the sizing was ambiguous, but M size fits perfectly for my 6kg pup - it's like other brands' small size. You do need to trim the tail area though. The design is cute and it's a great value product, plus the shipping was super fast.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 진짜저렴하게 삿어요! 울 강쥐 거기가 튀어나와있어서 감염 위험때문에 항강 기저귀하고 나가는데 앞으로도 여기서 살게요! 근데 기저귀 양쪽 끝이 다른 기저귀에 비해 뭐랄까..ㅋㅋㅋ마감이 좋진않아요 그래도 흡수에는 문제없고 착용에도 문제없어요
reviews.content_en: Really cheap! My pup has an anatomical abnormality so there's infection risk, and I need to wear diapers whenever I go out. I'll keep buying from here! But the edges on both sides aren't as finished as other diapers ;; Still, there's no issue with absorption or wearing.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
유치원 등원 필수템 바잇미 기저귀
흡수력도 좋고 찍찍이 면적도 넓은 편이라
고정도 잘 된답니다. 가성비 만점인 잇템이라 꾸준히 구매하고 있어요.👍
reviews.content_en:
Essential item for kindergarten pups - BITE ME diapers
Great absorption and the adhesive tabs are wide,
so the fit is solid. It's such great value that I keep buying it consistently.👍

reviews.name: 강****
reviews.content: 유치원 다니는 댕댕이에겐 필수품인데,하루종일써봣는데 불편해하지도 않고 잘있어요,사이즈s인데 2.7키로에게 넉넉히잘맞아요
reviews.content_en: It's a must-have for my pup who goes to kindergarten. I used it all day and she didn't feel uncomfortable at all, wearing it well. Size S fits my 2.7kg pup with plenty of room.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
강아지 기저귀는 처음 구입해봐요. 입양하고 3일만에 바로 배변을 잘 가려서 여지껏 구입해볼 생각을 못했는데 나이가 점점 드니 비상용으로 필요하겠단 생각에 구입했어요 
닥스훈트고 몸무게 6.8kg인데 L사이즈 구입했더니 딱 맞아요. 후기를 보니 작다는 소리가 있어서 넉넉하게 입혀보자 싶었어요. 착용샷만 찍어보고자 입혀봤는데 소변을 보진 않았는데 잘 입고 있네요 ㅎㅎ
다리힘이 있을 때까진 배변판에 잘 가리길 바라는데 여름휴가대비 겸 구입해봤어요.
reviews.content_en:
This is my first time buying dog diapers. My adopted pup started using the bathroom properly just 3 days after adoption, so I hadn't thought of buying any until now. But as she's getting older, I thought I'd need them for emergencies. 

My Dachshund weighs 6.8kg and I bought L size, and it fits perfectly. I saw comments saying it runs small, so I wanted to put it on loosely. I just put it on to take a picture, and she hasn't peed yet but she's wearing it well ㅎㅎ

I'm hoping she continues to use the bathroom properly while she still has the strength in her legs. I bought this as preparation for summer vacation.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
6살 토이푸들 생리기간이 생각보다 길어서 주문했은데 배송도 빠르고 크기도 스몰 잘 맞고
처음 쓰는데도 잘 차고 있네요
패드 차고 쉬야도 한번 했었는데
흡수력도 좋앗어요
reviews.content_en:
My 6-year-old Toy Poodle's heat cycle was longer than expected so I ordered these. Shipping was fast and Small size fits perfectly.

Even though it's my first time using it, she's wearing it well.

I put the pad on and she peed once,
and the absorption was great.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 강아지 기저귀 착용시킬때 항상 제일 중요하게 보는게 부드러움이예요! 본가 18살 강아지가 기저귀 잘못사서 진물로 고생한번 해보니 다른거 다 필요없고 부드러움이 젤 중요하더라구요! 자극없이 착용이 가능하다는거에 너무 만족스럽게 쓰고있습니다!
reviews.content_en: When putting diapers on my dog, the most important thing I look at is softness! My 18-year-old pup at home suffered from discharge because I bought the wrong diapers once, so nothing else matters except softness! I'm very satisfied that I can put them on without irritation!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
3.8kg 딱 맞아요. 배둘레 안재고 구매했는데 더 큰 키로수면 사이즈 업 하시는게 좋을것 같습니다.
 슬개골수술하고 쉬를 너무 참다 한번에 해서 아무리 좋은 패드여도 쉬하고 나면 몸이 축축해져 더 참는 악순환이 반복되길래 구매했어요. 무게 재보니 쉬를 100ml했는데 어디하나 새지 않고 흡수 잘되어서 만족합니다!
reviews.content_en:
Perfect fit for 3.8kg. I didn't measure the belly circumference before buying, but I'd suggest sizing up for heavier weight ranges.

After my pup's patellar surgery, she was holding her pee too much and would let it all out at once. No matter how good the pad, her body would get wet after peeing, creating a vicious cycle of holding it more. That's why I bought this. I measured and she peed 100ml, and there was no leaking anywhere - the absorption is great and I'm satisfied!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 저희집 15살 강아지가 필요하게 되서 처음이라 이것저것 두어번 구매했는데~~~와! 완전 대만족입니다! 역시 가격도 저렴하면서 품질까지~~~정착하렵니다! 굿~~~~
reviews.content_en: My 15-year-old pup needed them, so as a first-timer I bought a couple different ones and~~~wow! Totally satisfied! The price is affordable and the quality is great too~~~I'm sticking with this brand! Good~~~~

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
배송 빨라요~~ 보솜패드 사용 중이라 매너패드도 바잇미로 
ㅋㅋ 너무 귀엽고 애기 사이즈에 넉넉하게 잘 맞아요!
reviews.content_en:
Shipping is fast~~ I'm already using BITE ME absorbent pads so I got the manner pads from BITE ME too.

They're so cute and fit my pup's size generously!

reviews.name: 권****
